name: Recurly
tagline: Subscription billing and revenue management API for SaaS and digital businesses.
description: Recurly provides a REST API for subscription management, recurring billing, invoices, payments, dunning, and revenue recognition. Developers manage accounts, plans, subscriptions, and transactions programmatically with JSON over HTTPS.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (API key as username, empty password) or Authorization: Basic header; keys from Recurly admin.

use_cases: create a subscription for a customer
